about: Breaking releases not yet adopted — a new major, or below 1.0 a new minor (give `minor` too) — each with why and until when. Read by scripts/check-dependency-drift.mjs: an entry past its reviewBy date, or one matching nothing outdated, fails the check. Remove an entry in the commit that adopts the major.

deferrals.reason: The designer draws through @iyulab/u-board, which pins the viewer at ^0.6.1 until its next release; raising only the designer puts two copies of the viewer in the app and a test's mock of the package reaches only one of them. Adopt in the commit that moves @iyulab/u-board to a release that pins ^0.7.0.
